# Results (generated by src/analysis.py; do not edit by hand)

## Headline numbers

- The more valuable squad won 72 of 80 matches that had a winner after 90/120 min (90%); 24 of 104 were draws.
- 27 of the 32 most valuable squads reached the Round of 32.
- 11 of the 16 most valuable reached the Round of 16; 4 of the 8 most valuable reached the quarter-finals; 3 of the 4 most valuable reached the semi-finals.
- Knockout ties: the more valuable side went through in 25 of 31; when the two squads were within 1.5× in value, 6 of 10.
- Against a value-only expectation: 23 teams finished exactly where value ranked them, 14 went further, 11 fell short.

## Association with stage reached (Spearman ρ, bootstrap 95% CI, n=48)

- Squad market value: ρ = 0.72 [0.53, 0.85]
- FIFA ranking: ρ = 0.64 [0.42, 0.80]
- Bookmaker title odds: ρ = 0.74 [0.57, 0.85]
